note: Test-id ledger for the engine-split Phase 1 batch 1d, built against the batch base 0fa3b66fc (main after 1b). Ids are relative to each collection's ROOT. Run: node scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs --before <before-engine.json>=<base>/packages/engine --before <before-matrix.json>=<base>/tools/matrix --before <before-scripts.json>=<base> --after <after-engine.json>=packages/engine --after <after-matrix.json>=tools/matrix --after <after-scripts.json>=. --after <after-web.json>=apps/web --ledger this-file. Collect each side with `vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <f> <files>` (--isolate on BOTH sides: batch 1b review m4), from the engine package for the engine report and from the repo root with the engine's vitest binary for the other two. Task 1d-0 (scripts/lib/test-parity.mjs compares ids as a multiset, commit 497849e76): scripts/__tests__/test-parity.test.ts, collected whole on both sides; the two tests that asserted a duplicate id is refused are retired (behaviour deliberately reversed) and the multiset tests are added. Task 1d-1 (Stryker tests and stryker-changed.mjs layout-agnostic): engine = the eleven test/stryker-*.test.ts files (outputs-ignored, sizing, changed-lines, matrix, cuts, floor, generator-exclusion, groups, runner, sandbox-safe, vitest-runner), tools/matrix = __tests__/matrix-workflow.test.ts. No moved test changed its title except the split fan-out test of stryker-sizing.test.ts (retitled 'the workflow quotes' for the engine half; the matrix-workflow.test.ts half is a new test in that file). The enginePrefix test is the only added engine test. Later tasks of batch 1d append their own entries to this file. Review fix of 1d-1 (commit 'fix(engine): 1d-1 review'): test/stryker-sandbox-safe.test.ts gains the four layout-importer tests (`added`); the anchor pin and the dropped equivalent guard in test-parity change assertions or code, no title. Task 1d-2 (engine-boundary moves into the engine): no id changes, so no entries. Collected additionally on both sides: engine test/boundary-gate.test.ts (14 cases, now importing ../scripts/engine-boundary.ts) and root scripts/__tests__/main-module.test.ts (4 cases; the symlinked-spawn test keeps its title, which names scripts/engine-boundary.ts package-relative). packages/engine/eslint.config.mjs line 19 still imports ../../scripts/lib/tools-import-guard.mjs; it stays until 2b (D32d), and the engine's own copy of main-module.ts (packages/engine/scripts/lib/) is a copy by design: the root copy stays for the other root scripts. Review fix of 1d-2 (commit 'fix(engine): 1d-2 review'): the five `added` ids above (three boundary-gate CLI tests, the ci-wiring entry-point pin, the main-module copy-identity test); ci-wiring.test.ts is collected whole on both sides (49 earlier ids unchanged); no existing id changed. Task 1d-3 (window-single-source): the two apps/web tests move to apps/web/src/server/usecases/__tests__/court-window-single-source.test.ts (collected from apps/web, after side only; the web file does not exist at the base) and the engine file keeps its four engine-only tests. Collected: engine src/scheduling/window-single-source.test.ts on both sides. The apps/web report is an AFTER-side report only and is collected from apps/web itself: `cd apps/web && DATABASE_URL= ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run --isolate -t __parity_collect_only__ --reporter=json --outputFile <after-web.json> src/server/usecases/__tests__/court-window-single-source.test.ts` (the empty DATABASE_URL keeps apps/web's vitest config from refusing a dev URL it loaded from .env.local). Review fix of 1d-3: one more `added` id (the floor's own test); the other review changes are assertions and comments, no title.
